script_text: Something in the skies is forcing Taurus to choose: comfort or reinvention. Over the weekend, Venus enters your Fifth House and sextiles Uranus in your Second House, bringing romance, income, or payment. By Sunday, Sun sextile Saturn steadies planning. Friday is your power day because Mars sextile Jupiter brings Fifth House opportunities. Thursday is your worst day because Venus square Jupiter in your Fourth and Third Houses overheats love and money. Pause buying, then send one polished revised pitch today. Follow for daily updates.
